summary: The note reports the University of Michigan School of Public Health's standing in US News & World Report's graduate program rankings for 2011. It was ranked the fourth best School of Public Health in the country, and its Healthcare Management program was ranked first nationally that year.
one_line: The University of Michigan School of Public Health's 2011 U.S. News rankings: fourth nationally overall and first in Healthcare Management.
key_facts: The University of Michigan School of Public Health was ranked the # 4 School of Public Health in the country in 2011.
The ranking was reported by US News & World Report in its report on graduate programs.
The University of Michigan School of Public Health had the # 1 Healthcare Management program in the country in 2011.
The 2011 ranking data comes from US News & World Report's graduate programs report.
The note describes the rankings as applying to the year 2011.
